assets.name: paper-blank
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE reusable game HUD background asset: a blank wide rectangle of warm ivory old paper with irregular naturally torn fibrous edges, soft age stains and subtle vintage printed grain, inspired by a Mediterranean paper collage surf game. Straight front view, no perspective. Paper takes 94% width and 88% height of a landscape 3:2 canvas. Cream center remains light and low contrast for readable dark numbers and labels overlaid by code. No text, no numbers, no icons, no borders, no tape, no objects. Transparent background outside paper. The physical sheet should have a wide approximately 1.65:1 aspect ratio, four torn edges, tiny soft contact shadow, authentic tactile paper.

assets.name: crown-cream
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE game control button background, no icon. A single beer bottle crown cap seen exactly from above, circular with 21 very distinct crimped serrated teeth around its circumference. Vintage paper collage style: worn cream enamel face, warm ivory and aged brass folded metal rim, subtle printed paper grain and tiny distressed marks. Thin dark petrol navy circular printed ring just inside the crown rim. Large plain blank cream center, suitable for overlaying dark arrow icons in code. Center cap perfectly centered, 92% of square canvas width and height. Flat top-down orthographic view, no perspective, minimal soft shadow. Transparent background, no text, no numbers, no logo, no arrow, no symbol. Clearly recognizable metal beer crown shape, beautifully tactile, muted warm ivory with dark teal ring.

usage: Blank backgrounds only. All numbers, labels, icons and progress bars rendered live by HTML/CSS. PNG masters and alpha-preserving WebP delivery copies. Jump uses the same crown with the navy paper texture layered inside its center in CSS.
